notes.text: The checked Bavli explicitly has Rav Bibi bar Giddel transmitting Rabbi Shimon the pious.
The checked Yerushalmi gives Bibi bar Gozlon in the same discussion of the difference between robbery and lost property. The phrase begins Rav Huna in this witness.

Keep Dela and Gola as reported readings and preserve the Gozel to Gozlon difference. The directly compared witnesses give Giddel in the Bavli and Gozlon in the Yerushalmi. The exact editions supporting Dela, Gola and Gozel have not been established.
